   - Many neurological and psychiatric disorders (e.g., Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and certain forms of epilepsy) manifest differently in humans compared to rodents or other animals.    - Research in NHPs has been pivotal in developing brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) and neuroprosthetics.
